programme.title: Tierra del Fuego
programme.desc: Finales del siglo XIX. Julius Popper, un ingeniero rumano toma posesión de la isla de Tierra del Fuego en nombre de la reina Carmen Sylba de Rumanía. En su gesta de conquista le acompañan diversos personajes de diferentes procedencias: Armenia, una bella prostituta; Spiro, un aventurero italiano; Shaeffer, un alemán destinado a ejercer de hombre fiel para todo; Novak, un austríaco nombrado general de este peculiar ejército; y Silveira, un gallego que no se separa de su gaita. Todos ellos deberán enfrentarse a la naturaleza y a sus propias pasiones en esta aventurera búsqueda de oro en Tierra del Fuego (aunque Popper fue, en verdad, fue uno de los principales gestores del genocidio selknam).

programme.title: Gata Selvagem

programme.title: Com Amor, Van Gogh
programme.desc: Um ano após o suicídio de Vincent Van Gogh, Armand Roulin (Douglas Booth) encontra uma carta por ele enviada ao irmão Theo, que jamais chegou ao seu destino. Após conversar com o pai, carteiro que era amigo pessoal de Van Gogh, Armand é incentivado a entregar ele mesmo a correspondência. Desta forma, ele parte para a cidade francesa de Arles na esperança de encontrar algum contato com a família do pintor falecido. Lá, inicia uma investigação junto às pessoas que conheceram Van Gogh, no intuito de decifrar se ele realmente se matou.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Perú, siglo XVIII. La historia se desplaza desde los burdeles y los teatros de Lima a la majestuosa Corte de España, desde los palacios arzobispales peruanos a la Inquisición de Madrid. Cuando el puente de San Luis se rompe, cinco viajeros se precipitan al abismo. ¿Es el azar o la mano de Dios lo que reunió a estas cinco personas en ese lugar en ese momento fatídico? O, por el contrario, ¿fueron ellos mismos los responsables de lo que ocurrió?

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.title: Retornados
programme.desc: La humanidad convive con los "Retornados", personas de aspecto normal que han sido infectadas por un virus devastador. Sólo la inyección diaria de una proteína impide que se conviertan en zombis. Kate trabaja en una unidad de investigación que intenta encontrar urgentemente una vacuna definitiva para detener la propagación de la epidemia. También oculta una poderosa razón: su compañero, Alex, es un "devuelto".

programme.title: Laços de um Crime
programme.desc: Quando a polícia descobre uma jovem brutalmente assassinada, os irmãos Joe Fairburn (Paul Bettany) e Chrissie Fairburn se juntam ao seu supervisor, Robert (Mark Strong), para investigar o principal suspeito: Jason Buliegh, um criminoso sexual. Forçados a liberar Jason da custódia da polícia, os Fairburns tomam o assunto em suas próprias mãos; sufocados pela sombra de seu pai.

programme.title: La diligencia: La historia de Texas Jack
programme.desc: El ex ladrón de diligencias, Nathaniel Reed inicia una nueva vida honesta junto su esposa Laura Lee. Pero ésta se interrumpe cuando su viejo compañero, Frank Bell, aparece para informar a Reed que lo quieren matar. Tras un tiroteo en el que supuestamente muere su esposa Laura, Reed huye con Bell y Sid Dalton, convirtiéndose en los forajidos más buscados.

programme.title: Castigo Del Cielo
programme.desc: El exitoso abogado neoyorquino Sam Leibowitz viaja al sur en 1933 para defender a nueve jóvenes negros acusados de violar a dos mujeres en un tren de carga de Alabama. En la primavera de 1931, nueve vagabundos negros fueron bajados de un tren de carga de Alabama y arrestados por presuntamente violar a dos jóvenes blancas en un vagón de góndola.

programme.title: October Gale
programme.desc: Una doctora invita en su casa a un hombre misterioso en su remota cabaña con una herida de bala.

programme.title: Massacre no Bairro Chinês
programme.desc: Jackie Chan faz o papel de um fugitivo do Japão que se torna um assassino para a máfia. O longa é focado na vida de imigrantes chineses que vivem no Japão.

programme.title: Black Rose
programme.desc: El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles contrata a un comandante de la policía rusa para ayudar a resolver una serie de horribles asesinatos perpetrados contra mujeres jóvenes por un sádico asesino sociópata en las calles de Hollywood.

programme.title: El sheriff Breaker

programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Sonic TV
programme.desc: The Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog 24/7

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: L’indic de Starsky et Hutch, Huggy-les-bons-tuyaux, est menacé de mort après qu’on lui ait dérobé une importante somme d’argent, une véritable fortune qui ne lui appartenait pas et qu’il était sur le point de rendre à son propriétaire, un gangster sans pitié.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Habillés comme des escrocs plus que clinquants pour attirer l’attention et avec l’aide d’une jolie blonde pour servir d’appât, Starsky et Hutch se font passer pour des trafiquants d’héroïne fortunés afin de gravir les échelons du narcotrafic et d’appréhender un important fournisseur d’héroïne.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Starsky et Hutch enquêtent sur le meurtre d’une magnifique policière ayant quitté les forces de l’ordre pour devenir danseuse dans un bar miteux après s’être séparée de Starsky.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Un industriel corrompu et fanatique commandite l’assassinat du capitaine Dobey et de sa famille par un fugitif, un ancien policier véreux que Dobey lui-même a fait arrêter et enfermer.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Starsky et Hutch enquêtent sur le meurtre d’un policier infiltré sur les docks. programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Starsky et Hutch acceptent d’aider un vieil ami à retrouver son jeune fils et son ex-femme maintenant remariée. Ils ignorent que leur ami est devenu un tueur à gages chargé d’exécuter le mari actuel de son ex-femme.

programme.desc: Lorsque Starsky et Hutch entrent dans un restaurant ouvert toute la nuit, ils sont capturés par deux tueurs à gages qui attendent l’arrivée de leur cible, un représentant syndical.

programme.title: Diabolique
programme.desc: Mia Baran (Isabelle Adjani) et Nicole Horner (Sharon Stone) s'associent pour planifier l'assassinat de Guy Baran (Chazz Palminteri), le mari de Mia. Elles le droguent, le noient dans la baignoire et déplacent le corps dans une piscine pour que tout le monde croit à un accident. Mais, lorsque la piscine est vidée, aucune trace de la victime n'est retrouvée. Guy est-il vraiment mort ? Mia et Nicole vont-elles s'en sortir ? Ou est-ce que quelqu'un d'autre leur joue un très mauvais tour ?

programme.title: Escape Game
programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Hanna (SAOIARSE RONAN) a 16 ans. Elle est intelligente, curieuse, jolie - et se révèle être un assassin professionnel. Ayant passé presque toute sa vie dans la toundra à apprendre des techniques de combat enseignées par son père (ERIC BANA), elle revient à la civilisation où un agent sans scrupules de la CIA (CATE BLANCHETT) tente de la faire disparaître. Tout en apprenant comment elle est devenue une machine à tuer, Hanna doit se battre pour survivre et finalement, éliminer la personne qui est responsable de ce qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Après dix ans passés en prison, le « Conducteur » n'a qu'une seule idée en tête : venger le meurtre de son frère, survenu durant un braquage de banque. Désormais libre, il se lance dans sa mission meurtrière, mais se voit traqué par un flic sur le point de prendre sa retraite et par un redoutable tueur à gages. Le chasseur devient la proie, et le « Conducteur » comprend vite que la mort de son frère cache bien des mystères. La liste des responsables pourrait même être incomplète…

programme.desc: Un jeune et talentueux chauffeur pour criminel (Ansel Elgort) compte sur le rythme de sa bande originale personnelle pour être le meilleur dans le milieu. Quand il rencontre la fille de ses rêves (Lily James), Baby voit une chance de laisser sa vie criminelle derrière lui et de s'enfuir sans laisser de traces. Mais après avoir été forcé à travailler pour un baron du crime (Kevin Spacey), il doit affronter les conséquences quand un braquage tourne mal et met en danger sa vie, son amour et sa liberté.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Après dix ans passés en prison, le « Conducteur » n'a qu'une seule idée en tête : venger le meurtre de son frère, survenu durant un braquage de banque. Désormais libre, il se lance dans sa mission meurtrière, mais se voit traqué par un flic sur le point de prendre sa retraite et par un redoutable tueur à gages. Le chasseur devient la proie, et le « Conducteur » comprend vite que la mort de son frère cache bien des mystères. La liste des responsables pourrait même être incomplète…

programme.title: Terminator Renaissance
programme.desc: En 2018, après l'apocalypse qui a vu s'affronter les hommes et les robots, John Connor est devenu le chef de la résistance humaine contre Skynet et son armée de Terminators. Sa vision du monde est pourtant remise en cause par l'apparition de Marcus Wright, un inconnu qui se souvient seulement de s'être trouvé dans le quartier des condamnés à mort. Connor doit découvrir si Marcus a été envoyé du futur ou s'il est un rescapé du passé. Alors que Skynet prépare l'assaut final, Connor et Marcus s'engagent dans une odyssée qui va les mener au cœur même des opérations de Skynet. Ils y perceront le terrible secret qui se cache derrière l'annihilation programmée de l'humanité tout entière...

programme.title: Flic de Haut Vol
programme.desc: Un cambrioleur se fait passer pour un flic pour récupérer un diamant volé.

programme.title: Camping Car
programme.desc: Pour Bob Munro, sa femme Jamie et leurs deux enfants, il devient urgent de resserrer les liens, sous peine de voir leur famille exploser. Bob avait promis d'emmener tout le monde à Hawaii, mais il a brusquement décidé qu'un long périple en camping-car serait bien plus excitant... Jamie et les enfants ne passent pas vraiment les vacances qu'ils espéraient.

programme.title: Good Luck Chuck
programme.desc: La superstar de Hollywood Jessica Alba (Fantastic Four, Into The Blue) et le comique Dane Cook tiennent la vedette dans cette comédie romantique désopilante. Un homme qui a rompu avec celle qui fut longtemps sa petite amie est surpris d'apprendre qu'elle a décidé de se fiancer avec celui qu'elle vient de rencontrer. Il répète le modèle et des célibataires commencent à le fréquenter dans l'espoir de trouver M. Parfait.

programme.title: 30 Ans Sinon Rien
programme.desc: Jenna, adolescente de treize ans qui rêve de devenir célèbre, s'enferme dans un placard après avoir subi une expérience humiliante. Lorsqu'elle se décide enfin de sortir de sa cachette, elle s'aperçoit que, par un phénomène extraordinaire et inexplicable, elle est sur le point de célébrer son trentième anniversaire et qu'elle est devenue extrêmement belle et populaire.Alors que Jenna commence à profiter de sa toute nouvelle vie, elle découvre que celui auquel elle tenait tant n'est plus là. Non seulement elle n'a plus aucune nouvelle de Matt, mais elle apprend qu'il s'apprête à épouser une autre demoiselle...

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: Michael est un comédien talentueux mais sans travail. Quand sa petite amie, Sandy, rate une audition pour un feuilleton télé, il se travestit en femme et obtient le rôle sous le nom de Dorothy Michaels. Il devient rapidement le confident de Julie, l'actrice avec qui il partage la vedette. Mais il en tombe bientôt amoureux et malheureusement, le père de Julie tombe aussi amoureux... de Dorothy.

programme.title: CLICK : télécommandez votre vie
programme.desc: Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) est marié à la belle Donna (Kate Beckinsale) ; ils ont deux adorables enfants, qu' il ne voit pas beaucoup parce qu'il passe trop de temps à son cabinet d'architecte.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: John Clasky (Adam Sandler) est un père dévoué dont les talents de chef ont permis à sa famille (Téa Leoni, Cloris Leachman) de vivre une vie de luxe. Ils possèdent une villa d'été à Malibu, dont s'occupe la magnifique gouvernante, Flor (Paz Vega), qui a quitté le Mexique pour immigrer à Los Angeles afin d'offrir une meilleure vie à sa remarquable fille, Cristina (Shelbie Bruce), qui embrasse très vite ce nouveau style de vie américain.

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Un cadre et un joueur de baseball professionnel se disputent l'affection de la même femme.

programme.title: Ma Meilleure Ennemie
programme.desc: sabel Kelly, jeune photographe de mode et petite amie de Luke Harrison, et Jackie, l'épouse légitime du même Luke, se détestent. Celle-ci, toujours très présente, ne pardonne pas à sa rivale son incapacité à l'égaler. Isabel ne parvient pas à se faire accepter d'Anna et de Ben, les deux enfants de Luke et de Jackie. C'est entre les deux femmes une sourde guerre de tranchées. Mais quand Jackie apprend qu'elle est atteinte d'un mal incurable, elle prend conscience que c'est Isabel qui va élever ses enfants. Jackie va alors enseigner é celle qui fut sa pire ennemie comment devenir une mère pour ses enfants.

programme.title: Une Équipe Hors Du Commun
programme.desc: La seconde guerre mondiale déclarée, les joueurs professionels de Base-Ball partent au front. Afin de sauver les clubs et le sport, des propriétaires de clubs s'associent pour créer une ligue de base-ball féminine.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Think Like A Man
programme.desc: Quatre femmes ont lu le livre Act Like a Lady, Think Like a Man, écrit par le célèbre humoriste-animateur radio Steve Harvey, et inspiré par sa rubrique 'Strawberry Letters' de son émission radio The Steve Harvey Morning Show. Steve Harvey remarquent que ces femmes sont capables de diriger une petite entreprise, de s'occuper à merveille d'une famille de trois jeunes enfants et ou encore de diriger un groupe communautaire en même temps, mais sont incapables de découvrir ce qui plaît aux hommes. Pour lui, elles ne doivent par chercher conseil auprès d'autres femmes : seul un homme peut leur dire comment séduire un homme et le garder. Cependant, tout ça n'est pas du goût de l'autre moitié des 4 couples...

programme.title: Private Resort
programme.desc: Ben et Jack, deux adolescents libres d'esprit, passent le week-end dans un hôtel de luxe, dans le but avoué de rencontrer des filles ! L’objet du désir de Jack est une riche beauté, Dana, et il fait tout pour l’attirer, même se faire passer pour un chirurgien. Ben, quant à lui, poursuit une ravissante serveuse, Patti, bien que le règlement interdise toute relation amoureuse avec les clients.

programme.title: L'or de Curly
programme.desc: Mitch Robbins part avec son frère Glen, et son ami de toujours Phil Berquist à la recherche du trésor de Curly, un cowboys qu'il a connu autrefois.

programme.desc: Addison gets roped into traveling overseas with her brother and his picky billionaire boss. But clashing with the billionaire is no vacation, until he starts to have a change of heart.

programme.title: Prescription For Love
programme.desc: Claire, a nurse, fights for a chance at love with a charming new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail Claire's chance at happiness, Claire will have to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: Same River Twice
programme.desc: Thirteen years ago, four men met on the river. Working as rafting guides, 21 year old Kurt, Stan, Mikey, and Skinner spent their days battling dangerous rapids, and their nights camped out under thousands of stars. It was the perfect summer until a fatal rafting accident claimed the life of their friend, Buck. Years later, the friends return to the river for one last whitewater thrill ride. However, they soon find that things aren't exactly how they remember. Life's experiences have changed the four friends and they're no longer the daredevils they once were. About to face the stretch of the river that took the life of their friend years ago, they must pull together in order to survive a hair-raising run down deadly rapids!

programme.title: Bookworm and the Beast
programme.desc: Izzy is ready to make a difference in the world as she starts her career in public relations. When Grant Beiste - the big-headed corporate celebrity in town - accidentally hits her father with a car, Izzy is thrown into a public scandal that forces her to work closely with Grant. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

programme.title: Dishing Up Love
programme.desc: A brilliant but lonely gourmet chef and a rugged diner cook go head-to-head in a big contest. It's a main course of sumptuous food with a side of spicy competition, and delectable antics for dessert. If only they can discover the ultimate recipe... the recipe for love.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Love Switch
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, James and Michelle wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through daily.

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.title: Changing Hearts
programme.desc: James Reed is quite content with the successful life he's built for himself, complete with beautiful girlfriend and great reputation in his big city career. After receiving an urgent call about his father's health, James reluctantly returns home to help with the family B&B business. James must learn about sacrificing for the ones he loves, even at the expense of his own dreams.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: To save her destitute family, Persephone Lancaster accepts a marriage proposal from Adam Boyce, the mysterious Duke of Kielder, the most feared man in the kingdom. Isolated in the duke’s foreboding castle, Persephone searches for what happiness she can find. But Adam’s determination to keep his new bride at a distance makes a future between them precarious.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: Though Adam is still confusing and distant, glimpses of the good man behind the frightening facade give Persephone some hope for their future. Word arrives of a deadly battle at sea, bringing Persephone’s world crashing down around her. Adam is at a loss to know how to ease her suffering. He is called away on an urgent rescue mission. Their brief time apart lays bare the attachment that is growing between them.

programme.title: Bookworm and the Beast
programme.desc: Izzy is ready to make a difference in the world as she starts her career in public relations. When Grant Beiste - the big-headed corporate celebrity in town - accidentally hits her father with a car, Izzy is thrown into a public scandal that forces her to work closely with Grant. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

programme.title: Dishing Up Love
programme.desc: A brilliant but lonely gourmet chef and a rugged diner cook go head-to-head in a big contest. It's a main course of sumptuous food with a side of spicy competition, and delectable antics for dessert. If only they can discover the ultimate recipe... the recipe for love.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Love Switch
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, James and Michelle wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through daily.

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Our Canyon truck got a new LS engine, today we give the truck a brake upgrade, new lower stance and turn this into the ultimate sleeper.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the interior of a C20. Changing out the seats, dash accessories and door panels. We’re going from Clean to Custom on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno show you how to personalize your Jeep with some paint and fabrication.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: It’s a fishing day on Truck U. Matt and Bruno take two trucks and get them ready to tow with a turbo rebuild and some towing accessories.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: To sell this Longbed C-10, Matt and Bruno need to get it back to stock. They transform the interior back to a factory style bench seat. The exhaust also gets a factory style upgrade.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Look to the West for B5 Blue
programme.desc: Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark’s A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix ‘Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their “pick of the show.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids é uma série musical animada em 3D que dá vida às alegres e afetuosas aventuras diárias da família Domi, composta por cinco membros. Com músicas animadas e divertidas, e performances de vários personagens, o programa oferece uma ampla variedade de temas, histórias envolventes e cenários diversificados. A equipe profissional de produção musical garante melodias de alta qualidade, arranjos cativantes e interpretações vocais impecáveis, proporcionando um verdadeiro banquete audiovisual para as crianças. O conteúdo é positivo, divertido e pensado para ajudar as crianças a aprenderem e explorarem o mundo de forma apropriada para sua idade. Também apoia os pais em sua jornada de uma criação mais leve e prazerosa, acompanhando o crescimento e o florescimento dos pequenos.

programme.title: Sopa de Letrinhas
programme.desc: Em 'Sopa de Letrinhas', Jacarelvis e seus Amigos exploram o encantador universo das letras, palavras e fonemas, em episódios rápidos de apenas 1 minuto. Uma série que concilia entretenimento e aprendizado com a temática de alfabetização para crianças de 1 a 5 anos.

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Mergulhe em uma série animada pré-escolar cheia de cores, música e aprendizado. A cada episódio, Jacarelvis e seus amigos conduzem os pequenos espectadores por uma jornada divertida e educativa, explorando conceitos como cores, sons de instrumentos musicais e brincadeiras interativas. Prepare-se para se encantar com as aventuras do Jacarelvis e sua turma, enquanto eles ensinam de forma lúdica e cativante.

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: A maximum-security prison goes into serious lockdown mode when a shape-shifting demon with an insatiable taste for human flesh unleashes its fury on the inmates and guards.

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Central Florida’s St. John’s River is home to countless species of wildlife, making this sweet water estuary the perfect playground for a pair of river rats, Captains Jonathan Moss and Nick Clark.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Captain C.A. heads to Brownsville, Texas, to chase trout and redfish with well-known local guide Captain Ernest Cisneros.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared and Father-Son duo Captain’s Hunter & Chris Barron have Sailfish in their sights.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss ventures to South Florida with the hope of having a few Exotic Encounters.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger chase the full moon Wahoo bite fishing out of Plantation Boat Mart.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: We are at West Boggs Lake in Indiana for annual veterans appreciation day. We are joined by Jeff and James Hall. Father and son. It was a great day just saying thanks to them for their service. Thanks to Centerpoint Energy and Indiana 811 for supporting this annual event and West Boggs Park.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush takes up an invite from good friend and fellow guide Jared Cyr to sight fish for barracuda and bonefish in the shallow waters of the Florida Keys. Meanwhile Rush's boat takes a break from charter fishing to get a new Seakeeper RIDE system installed.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a great trip fishing the flats, Rush returns the favor and extends an invite to friend Jarred Cyr fishing offshore. Fishing in Key West is all about the variety of species and opportunities they present. Mixing it up and taking advantage of this, the guys decide to see how many species they can catch using light spin and fly tackle offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The LK crew returns to Guatemala with more friends for our yearly dose of world class fishing! Year after year, Casa Vieja Lodge continues to impress with daily shots at sailfish, marlin, mahi, and tuna. Tag along on our 2nd annual group trip for a tropical fishing experience like no other!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and the new producer (Tim Guidroz) go out on their first turkey hunt together, and even though the weather is not ideal, they get the job done on a Wilkinson County gobbler. We also get a look at what the United Country - Southern States Realty office looks like during turkey season, with interviews from Scott Lindsey and Caleb Armstrong, and three big properties closing in Baton Rouge.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Opening Week in Mississippi started off with a BANG!!"
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.sub-title: "Islamorada Blackfins And Mahis With Capt Scott Stoky"
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve start the season with Capt. Scott Stoky chasing Islamorada Tunas and Mahis offshore out of Plantation Boat Mart.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve catch a mixed bag bottom fishing off of Islamorada with Captain Scott Stoky.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve go yellow tailing out of Hawks Cay for a limit of tasty yellowtail snapper and Steve picks a battle with a big lemon shark.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve bounce around the reefs out of Hawks Cay catching a wide variety of reef dwellers.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve take their brand new Invincible 36’ out of Plantation Boat Mart to fly the kites for some early season sailfishing.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve make a big run from Plantation Boat Mart in the Invincible 36’ into the green Gulf waters to fill the Yeti cooler and battle with some seas monsters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nobody chases the waterfowl migration as hard as Shawn Stahl of Team Winchester. The Michigan native spends over half of his year running the highways and flyways searching for the x. In this episode, we’ll tag along with Shawn and his crew with their Winchester pumps in hand as they hunker down hiding in fields and timber in hopes of locked wings from ducks and geese.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Overview: East Alton, Illinois is the home of Winchester Ammunition and the manufacturing home of the shotshell plants that build and produce millions of rounds of ammo for hunters, sport shooters, military and law enforcement. Get an unprecedented inside look at the birth cycle of a shotshell inside the walls of Winchester. From hull to primer, shot to wad and packaging to shipping, watch how the most legendary and successful ammunition brand in the world comes to is born and built.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins the legendary offshore Capt. Scott Stoky for a day of fishing in Islamorada, Florida.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins his long time friends Capt. Tyler Webb and Capt. Casey Yaworski on a hunt for Sails in Islamorada, Florida.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Mitch Widom, Andy Yaffa, & Chris Hammaway join Capt. Jared Raskob in Los Cabos on the hunt for Striped Marlin Part 1.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins Capt. Tucker Ersek and his father for a day of sail fishing off Ocean Reef in the Florida Keys.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Charles Rodney’s relationship with his hunting dogs, passion for field-to-table living and connection to the land make his love for chasing rabbits contagious while the heritage of Winchester’s small game ammunition makes this beloved pastime accessible for generations to come. Also: a Model 42 collection for the ages and hunting Kansas coyotes with the Keefer Brothers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Deer season — the sights, the sounds and the smells stick with you. It’s about remembering those who came before us and setting the right example for those who look up to us. It’s about protecting the tradition, so they always have something to look forward to. When communities come together, we see the real reason for this special time of year.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: On opening day of Missouri’s gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. For Nikki Boxler and the Winchester Deer Camp, it’s no different. With Winchester’s in hand, Nikki and crew play cat and mouse with several mature bucks at Indian Hill Outfitters in Pike County.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Orange Lake is a bass angler's paradise, known for its enormous trophy bass. On this episode of Local Lines TV, we dive into these rich waters to uncover the secrets of catching these giants. Get ready for thrilling action and expert tips from Brandon Branch and Trevor Fitzgerald.

programme.desc: Embark on a journey through Scotland's hunting traditions, exploring bird shoots, grouse moors, and red stag hunts while discovering the evolving role of hunting in conservation.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Navigating the complex issues of deer management, Dan Cabela travels between Scotland and England to learn how land managers balance conservation with wild food harvesting.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: This week, we reflect on a tragic and sad memory in our lives as we remember a dear childhood friend of my son Nick, Nathan Wimsatt. Our families have been close for man years and shared a lot of time together around the soccer field, vacations, fishing trips, and much more. Nathan passed in a tragic car accident at only 18 years on April 29th, 2023. This week his Dad Brian is joining me on Lake Taylorsville where we'll share some memories and celebrate Nathan's life...that ended way to soon!

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: This week we're joined by our good friend and Worship Leader, Rob Key. A tremendous musical talent that's chased the country music dream, but found his calling as worship leader at Taylorsville Community Church. Rob's love for serving the Lord is his top priority, but he certainly enjoys the great outdoors and especially doing a little fishing.
